policy.source_authority: Name backfill candidates require active official masterfile references for the exact ticker and exchange.
policy.no_guessing: Names are not inferred from ticker shape, issuer peers, or secondary-only sources.
policy.apply_gate: Report rows are review evidence; metadata updates are written only when --apply is used through the existing override workflow.
policy.otc_exclusion: OTC rows are excluded and must use the OTC name-mismatch review workflow.
